note: Literature confirms distinct allelic disorders for SPTAN1, with dHMN11 and spastic paraplegia/ataxia contrasting against severe developmental epileptic encephalopathies across different mutation types and domains.

evidence.text: Heterozygous variants in SPTAN1 are associated with an expanded phenotypic spectrum classified into distinct subgroups, from developmental epileptic encephalopathy to milder neurodevelopmental delay, hereditary spastic paraplegia, and hereditary motor neuropathies.
